headline: Take the pressure off your front desk, and stop enquiries slipping away
sub: Your receptionist cannot greet a patient and answer the phone at once. When the booking calls and messages they cannot reach are answered for them, they can give their attention to the person in the room.

changes.title: A calmer desk, and fewer missed enquiries

cards.title: No more choosing who to ignore
cards.text: When the phone rings during check-in, it is still answered, so your team can stay with the patient in front of them.

cards.title: Fewer call-backs to chase
cards.text: Routine bookings, changes and cancellations are handled as they come in, so the list of people to ring back is shorter.

cards.title: Handed over properly
cards.text: Anything that is not a booking is passed to your team with a note of what was asked, so nobody starts from scratch.

closing: Ready to take the pressure off your front desk?
